title: Act: Confirm Tick collects errors and continues after a Controller failure
summary: Confirm Tick keeps iterating after an Open error and returns the joined errors
description: Tick appends wrapped errors and returns errors.Join. Read it and make it match; change nothing if it already does. Result: an Open failure is returned and later rounds are still processed.
acceptance_criteria: Tick never returns early from the rounds loop on an Open or Close error
The returned error wraps the Controller error so errors.Is matches it

preserve: Error messages prefixed with round: open and round: close

steps.action: Confirm the Open and Close error branches only append fmt.Errorf(... %w, err) to errs without return or continue-out-of-loop, and that the function ends with return errors.Join(errs...); edit only if not
steps.code: errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("round: open %s/%s: %w", worldID, rd.ID, err))
steps.expected: A failing Open is wrapped, the loop continues, and Close for the next round still runs
